How to play
  • The ball shows its pace, line and length. Swing, cut and slower balls stay hidden until you play.
  • Tap a shot as the ball reaches the bat: Defend, Drive, Cut, Pull, Loft, or Leave. Keys: ↓ defend, Space drive, ← cut, → pull, ↑ loft, L leave.
  • Timing is judged on-chain: within 60 ms is perfect, 130 ms good, 240 ms an edge, beyond that you miss.
  • Each side bats one over with two wickets. A tie goes to another Super Over.
